recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Whisk together eggs, Pecorino Romano, and Parmesan in a bowl. Season with black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Remove pan from heat, add pasta to pancetta, then pour egg mixture over it.
Toss quickly, adding pasta water gradually until creamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and red chili flakes in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt.
Drain pasta and toss with the arrabbiata sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente.
Melt butter in a large pan over low heat.
Add heavy cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan until sauce is smooth and creamy.
Drain pasta and toss with sauce. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan.

recipes.title: Lasagna Bolognese
instructions: Brown ground beef and pork with onion, garlic, and carrot in olive oil.
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, and red wine. Simmer 30 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually add milk until thick.
Layer lasagna sheets, bolognese, and béchamel in a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toast coarsely ground black pepper in a dry pan for 1 minute.
Add a splash of pasta water to the pan and let it reduce.
Remove from heat, add drained pasta and toss.
Add Pecorino Romano and Parmesan gradually with pasta water, tossing vigorously.
Serve immediately with extra pepper.

recipes.title: Tagliatelle with Mushroom Cream Sauce
instructions: Cook tagliatelle in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter with garlic until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add white wine and let it reduce for 2 minutes.
Pour in heavy cream and simmer until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce.
Serve with Parmesan and fresh thyme.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and anchovies in olive oil until anchovies dissolve.
Add crushed tomatoes, olives, capers, and chili flakes. Simmer 15 minutes.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Rigatoni alla Norma
instructions: Salt eggplant cubes and let rest 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Fry eggplant in olive oil until golden. Set aside.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and basil. Simmer 15 minutes.
Cook rigatoni until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and eggplant.
Top with ricotta salata and fresh basil. Serve.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
instructions: Sauté onion, celery, carrot, and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add rosemary, tomato paste, and cannellini beans. Cook 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, then return to pot.
Add ditalini pasta and cook until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and extra olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Bucatini all'Amatriciana
instructions: Cook guanciale in a pan until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Sauté chili flakes and white wine in the same pan for 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook bucatini in salted water until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and guanciale.
Serve with grated Pecorino Romano.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli Rabe
instructions: Blanch broccoli rabe in boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Cook orecchiette in the same water until al dente.
Sauté garlic, chili, and anchovies in olive oil until fragrant.
Add broccoli rabe and toss for 2 minutes.
Drain pasta and combine with broccoli mixture.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and Pecorino.

recipes.title: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and fresh basil. Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook gnocchi in salted boiling water until they float to the surface.
Remove gnocchi with a slotted spoon and add to the tomato sauce.
Toss gently and serve with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
instructions: Soak clams in cold salted water for 30 minutes to remove grit.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil. Add clams and white wine.
Cover and cook until clams open, about 5 minutes. Discard any that stay closed.
Toss drained pasta with the clam sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté zucchini, bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and asparagus in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 more minute.
Toss vegetables with drained pasta and Parmesan.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh basil. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and Gruyère until melted.
Combine sauce with pasta. Transfer to a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Linguine with Pesto and Green Beans
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic, and olive oil into a smooth pesto.
Cook linguine in salted boiling water. Add green beans in the last 5 minutes.
Reserve pasta water, drain pasta and beans.
Toss with pesto, adding pasta water to loosen.
Serve with extra Parmesan and pine nuts.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, red wine, and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti until al dente and toss with the sauce.
Serve with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Tortellini in Brodo
instructions: Bring a rich beef or chicken broth to a gentle simmer.
Add fresh tortellini and cook according to package instructions.
Ladle into bowls with generous amounts of broth.
Serve with grated Parmesan and a crack of black pepper.

recipes.title: Farfalle with Salmon and Cream
instructions: Cook farfalle in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté shallot in butter until translucent.
Add smoked salmon pieces and cook 1 minute.
Pour in cream and simmer until thickened. Add lemon zest.
Toss drained pasta with the salmon cream sauce.
Serve with fresh dill and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Pasta Fagioli con Salsiccia
instructions: Brown Italian sausage, breaking it up, in a large pot.
Add onion, garlic, carrot, and celery. Cook until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, beans, and chicken broth. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add ditalini and cook until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh rosemary.
Serve with crusty bread and olive oil.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Thinly slice garlic and gently toast in olive oil until golden.
Add chili flakes and a ladle of pasta water. Stir to emulsify.
Drain pasta and toss in the garlic oil.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Ravioli with Butter and Sage
instructions: Cook fresh ravioli in salted boiling water until they float.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat until it starts to foam.
Add fresh sage leaves and cook until butter turns light brown and sage is crispy.
Drain ravioli and toss in the browned butter and sage.
Serve with Parmesan and a pinch of nutmeg.

recipes.title: Pasta al Forno
instructions: Cook rigatoni until slightly underdone. Drain.
Make a tomato meat sauce with ground beef, crushed tomatoes, and herbs.
Mix pasta with sauce, mozzarella cubes, and hard-boiled eggs.
Transfer to a baking dish and top with more sauce and Parmesan.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package, rinse under cold water, and drain.
Whisk together tahini, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Toss noodles with the sesame sauce.
Top with julienned cucumber, shredded carrot, and green onions.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chili oil. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and lime juice for the sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp and tofu in oil until cooked. Push to the side.
Scramble eggs in the pan, then add noodles and sauce.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve with bean sprouts, peanuts, lime, and green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, and garam masala for 1 hour.
Grill or broil chicken until slightly charred, about 10 minutes.
Sauté onion in butter until golden. Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes.
Add tomato puree, cream, and spices. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add grilled chicken and simmer 10 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken with Herbs
instructions: Pat chicken dry and season generously inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff cavity with lemon halves, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Rub skin with softened butter mixed with thyme and rosemary.
Roast at 200°C for 1 hour 20 minutes, basting every 30 minutes.
Let rest 15 minutes before carving.
Serve with pan juices and roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Grill 6 minutes per side.
Whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire, anchovy paste, and Parmesan for dressing.
Toss chopped romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Slice grilled chicken and place on top.
Garnish with croutons, shaved Parmesan, and black pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken into strips and season with cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken in a hot cast iron pan with oil until charred and cooked through.
Remove chicken and sauté sliced bell peppers and onion until tender.
Serve chicken and vegetables in warm flour tortillas.
Top with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, and fresh lime.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour and shake off excess.
Pan-fry in olive oil and butter until golden, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Add white wine to the pan and reduce by half.
Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer 3 minutes.
Return chicken to pan, spoon sauce over. Serve with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garam masala, turmeric, and chili for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked. Set aside.
Melt butter and sauté onion, garlic, ginger until soft.
Add tomato puree, kashmiri chili, and spices. Cook 10 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth. Return to pan and add cream.
Add chicken and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with naan and rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Season and dredge in flour.
Pan-fry in olive oil and butter until golden. Remove and set aside.
Sauté mushrooms in the same pan until golden.
Add Marsala wine and reduce by half.
Add chicken broth and simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pan and cook 5 more minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks and marinate in soy sauce, egg, and cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken until crispy and golden. Drain on paper towels.
Make sauce: soy sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger, and chili.
Stir-fry sauce in a wok for 1 minute.
Add fried chicken and toss to coat.
Serve over steamed rice with broccoli and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, and turmeric for 2 hours.
Grill or roast chicken at 220°C until cooked through and slightly charred.
Slice chicken thinly.
Serve in flatbread with garlic sauce, tomatoes, cucumbers, and pickled turnip.
Drizzle with tahini and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in butter and oil in a Dutch oven. Remove.
Sauté pearl onions, mushrooms, and bacon until golden.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and chicken stock. Add thyme and bay leaf.
Return chicken, cover and braise at 160°C for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Dredge in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Place on a baking tray, top with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with spaghetti and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add curry powder, cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook 2 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and brown on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and crushed tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes.
Season with salt and garnish with cilantro.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes and marinate in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and paprika.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Make tzatziki: mix yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, dill, and lemon.
Serve skewers in warm pita with tzatziki, tomatoes, and onion.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Pan-sear in oil, skin side down, until golden. Flip and cook 5 more minutes.
Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and butter in a bowl.
Pour sauce over chicken and cook 5 minutes, basting frequently.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add ras el hanout, ginger, and saffron.
Add chicken broth, preserved lemon, and green olives.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and parsley.
Serve with couscous or flatbread.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook and shred chicken breast. Season with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Mix chicken with cream cheese and half the shredded cheese.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until bubbly.
Garnish with sour cream, avocado, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken and Mushroom Pie
instructions: Cook diced chicken and mushrooms in butter until golden.
Make a sauce with flour, chicken stock, and cream. Season well.
Combine chicken mixture with sauce. Allow to cool.
Pour filling into a pie dish. Top with puff pastry, crimping edges.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and thyme.
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with Greek salad and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a pot.
Add chicken pieces and marinate 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove chicken and pan-fry in oil until golden and crispy.
Reduce the braising liquid until syrupy and pour over chicken.
Serve with steamed white rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Schnitzel
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to 5mm thickness between plastic wrap.
Season, then coat in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs in that order.
Pan-fry in clarified butter over medium-high heat, 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with potato salad, lemon wedges, and lingonberry jam.

recipes.title: Thai Green Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry green curry paste in a wok with a splash of coconut milk for 2 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and stir-fry until sealed.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer.
Add Thai eggplant, zucchini, and fish sauce. Cook 10 minutes.
Stir in fresh basil and lime juice.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour, egg, and panko breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 170°C for 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Make katsu sauce: mix Worcestershire, ketchup, soy sauce, and sugar.
Slice chicken and serve over steamed rice with shredded cabbage and sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Season and cook chicken breast, then shred.
Mix chicken with sautéed peppers, onion, and spices.
Lay a tortilla flat, add cheese and chicken mixture on half.
Fold over and cook in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer whole chicken in water with onion, celery, carrot, and bay leaf for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred the meat, and discard bones and skin.
Strain broth and return to pot.
Add sliced carrots, celery, and onion to the broth. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add egg noodles and shredded chicken. Cook until noodles are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, biryani spices, and fried onion for 1 hour.
Parboil basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot, top with rice.
Add saffron milk, fried onions, and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 30 minutes.
Serve with raita and pickled onions.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burger
instructions: Mix ground beef with Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Form into 4 patties, pressing a dimple in the center of each.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Add cheese in the last minute and let it melt.
Toast buns on the grill.
Serve with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup, and mustard.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut beef into 3cm chunks. Season well with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in batches in oil in a Dutch oven. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in beef stock and red wine. Add thyme and bay leaves.
Return beef, add potatoes. Cover and simmer 1.5 hours until tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer until absorbed.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry pan or directly over flame.
Fill tacos with beef, shredded cheese, and your choice of toppings.
Top with pico de gallo, sour cream, guacamole, and fresh cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Wellington
instructions: Sear beef tenderloin in hot oil until browned all over. Cool completely.
Brush with English mustard.
Blend mushrooms into a fine duxelles and cook until dry. Cool.
Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread duxelles, place beef on edge and roll tightly. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Wrap in puff pastry, seal edges, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Freeze for 30 minutes for easier slicing.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and pear juice for marinade.
Marinate beef for at least 1 hour.
Cook in a hot wok or grill pan over high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Sear beef quickly in a hot pan with oil. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and mushrooms until golden.
Add garlic and tomato paste. Cook 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and return beef. Heat gently and serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Beef Rendang
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, galangal, and chilies into a paste.
Fry paste in oil until fragrant, about 10 minutes.
Add beef chunks and stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk and add toasted coconut, kaffir lime leaves, and turmeric.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Cook until liquid is absorbed and beef is dark and tender. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Steak with Chimichurri
instructions: Bring steaks to room temperature. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear in a cast iron pan with oil over high heat, 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest steaks for 5 minutes.
Make chimichurri: blend parsley, oregano, garlic, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and chili flakes.
Slice steak and serve with chimichurri and roasted potatoes.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy sauce, cornstarch, and sesame oil.
Make sauce: oyster sauce, soy sauce, beef broth, sugar, and cornstarch.
Blanch broccoli florets for 2 minutes. Drain.
Stir-fry beef over high heat until browned. Remove.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger, add broccoli, then beef and sauce.
Toss everything together until sauce thickens. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
instructions: Mix ground beef with breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, garlic, and herbs.
Roll into golf ball sized meatballs.
Brown meatballs in olive oil on all sides. Remove.
Make tomato sauce with garlic, crushed tomatoes, basil, and seasoning.
Add meatballs to sauce and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with spaghetti or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large pot. Drain excess fat.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook until soft.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, paprika, and cayenne.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with sour cream, cheddar, green onions, and cornbread.

recipes.title: Beef Kebabs
instructions: Mix ground beef with grated onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Knead well for 2 minutes until mixture is sticky.
Shape onto metal skewers into long sausage shapes.
Grill over high heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve with flatbread, hummus, tahini, tomatoes, and onion salad.

recipes.title: Beef Pot Roast
instructions: Season chuck roast generously with salt and pepper.
Sear all sides in a Dutch oven until deeply browned.
Remove beef and sauté onion, carrots, and celery.
Add garlic, tomato paste, red wine, and beef broth.
Return beef with potatoes, thyme, and rosemary.
Cover and braise in oven at 160C for 3 hours until fork tender.

recipes.title: Beef Pho
instructions: Char onion and ginger directly over flame until blackened.
Simmer beef bones with charred onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, and cloves for 3 hours.
Strain broth and season with fish sauce and salt.
Cook rice noodles according to package.
Divide noodles into bowls, top with thinly sliced raw beef.
Pour boiling broth over to cook the beef. Serve with bean sprouts, basil, lime, and chili.

recipes.title: Beef Empanadas
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes.
Add chopped hard-boiled eggs, green olives, and raisins. Cool completely.
Roll out pastry dough and cut into circles.
Fill each circle with beef mixture, fold, and crimp edges.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Beef Shawarma
instructions: Marinate beef strips in shawarma spices, yogurt, lemon, and garlic for 2 hours.
Cook beef in a hot pan or grill until charred and cooked through.
Warm flatbreads on the grill.
Layer beef with garlic sauce, pickled vegetables, and tomatoes.
Roll tightly and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef Lasagna
instructions: Make bolognese: brown beef with onion, carrot, celery, garlic, wine, and tomatoes. Simmer 30 min.
Make bechamel: cook butter and flour, add milk gradually until thick.
Layer lasagna sheets, bolognese, and bechamel in a deep baking dish.
Finish with bechamel, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake at 180C for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes until golden. Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Ribeye Steak with Garlic Butter
instructions: Take steaks out of fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Season generously with salt and coarse black pepper on both sides.
Heat cast iron pan until smoking. Add oil and sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme to pan. Baste steaks continuously for 2 minutes.
Rest steaks on a rack for 5-10 minutes.
Slice against the grain and serve with the pan butter.

recipes.title: Beef Kofta Curry
instructions: Mix ground beef with onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, and fresh herbs.
Shape into small balls and fry until browned. Set aside.
Make curry: fry onion, garlic, ginger, and spices until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates.
Add koftas and simmer in the curry for 20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Brown bacon lardons in a Dutch oven. Remove.
Brown beef cubes in batches in the bacon fat. Remove.
Saute pearl onions, carrots, and mushrooms until golden.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and beef stock. Add herbs and return beef and bacon.
Braise covered at 160C for 2 hours until tender. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Beef Gyros
instructions: Marinate beef strips in olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, and paprika.
Grill or pan-fry beef until cooked and slightly charred.
Warm pita breads.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill.
Fill pitas with beef, tzatziki, tomatoes, and onion.
Wrap and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef Bibimbap
instructions: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar.
Cook spinach, bean sprouts, and carrots separately, season each.
Fry beef until cooked. Set aside.
Make bibimbap sauce: gochujang, sesame oil, garlic, sugar, and vinegar.
Divide hot rice into bowls, arrange vegetables and beef on top.
Add a fried egg and drizzle with bibimbap sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Satay
instructions: Cut beef into cubes and marinate in soy sauce, turmeric, garlic, and lemongrass.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Make peanut sauce: blend peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, lime, and chili.
Serve satay with peanut sauce and cucumber slices.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Picanha Steak
instructions: Score the fat cap in a crosshatch pattern. Season only with coarse salt.
Cook fat side down in a cast iron pan over medium heat for 5 minutes to render fat.
Flip and sear each side over high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain and serve with farofa and vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef pieces in a large pot. Remove.
Saute onion, celery, and carrots until soft.
Return beef with beef broth, diced tomatoes, and bay leaves.
Simmer for 1 hour until beef is tender.
Add potatoes, corn, and green beans. Cook 20 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon Butter
instructions: Pat salmon fillets dry and season with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Grill skin side down over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes.
Flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Make lemon butter: melt butter with lemon zest, lemon juice, and capers.
Pour lemon butter over salmon and serve with asparagus or green beans.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente.
Saute garlic in butter and olive oil until golden.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice. Simmer 2 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta and fresh parsley.
Season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Fish and Chips
instructions: Make batter: mix flour, baking powder, salt, and cold beer until smooth.
Cut potatoes into thick chips. Par-boil for 5 minutes. Drain and dry.
Deep fry chips at 160C for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Dip fish fillets in batter and deep fry at 180C until golden, about 5 minutes.
Increase oil to 190C and fry chips again until crispy.
Serve with mushy peas, tartar sauce, and malt vinegar.

recipes.title: Paella
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and red pepper in olive oil in a paella pan.
Add chorizo and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in rice and coat in the oil.
Add saffron-infused broth and crushed tomatoes. Do not stir.
Add shrimp, mussels, and squid on top. Cook uncovered 20 minutes.
Let rest 5 minutes, then garnish with lemon and parsley.

recipes.title: Tuna Poke Bowl
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Cube sashimi-grade tuna and toss with soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger.
Divide rice into bowls.
Arrange tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, and shredded carrot on top.
Drizzle with spicy mayo and soy sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds, nori strips, and green onion.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Lobster Tails
instructions: Split lobster tails in half lengthwise with kitchen scissors.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and olive oil.
Broil cut side up for 8-10 minutes until opaque.
Make garlic butter: melt butter with garlic, lemon juice, and parsley.
Spoon garlic butter over lobster and broil 2 more minutes.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Cod
instructions: Mix white miso, mirin, sake, and sugar to make the glaze.
Coat cod fillets with miso glaze and marinate 30 minutes.
Broil or grill for 5-6 minutes until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve with steamed bok choy and jasmine rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onion.

recipes.title: Prawn Curry
instructions: Saute onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add curry powder, turmeric, and chili. Cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add prawns and cook for 5 minutes until pink.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki
instructions: Make teriyaki sauce: combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Season salmon with salt and pan-fry skin side down in oil for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour teriyaki sauce over salmon and glaze for 1 minute.
Serve with steamed rice, broccoli, and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Ceviche
instructions: Cut fresh fish into 1cm cubes. Place in a glass bowl.
Pour lime juice over fish, making sure all pieces are submerged.
Marinate in the fridge for 15-20 minutes until opaque.
Add red onion, aji amarillo, cilantro, and salt.
Serve immediately with sweet potato, corn, and cancha corn nuts.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Tomatoes
instructions: Place cod fillets in a baking dish.
Scatter cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, and garlic around the fish.
Drizzle with olive oil, add white wine and lemon juice.
Season with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Serve with crusty bread to soak up the juices.

recipes.title: Lobster Bisque
instructions: Saute lobster shells in butter with onion, celery, and carrot.
Add tomato paste, brandy, and white wine. Cook 5 minutes.
Add fish stock and thyme. Simmer 30 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve. Return to pot.
Add cream and blend until smooth.
Add lobster meat, season, and serve with crusty bread and fresh chives.

recipes.title: Grilled Octopus
instructions: Simmer octopus with bay leaves, peppercorns, and wine for 45-60 minutes until tender.
Remove and cut into portions. Pat dry.
Drizzle with olive oil and grill over high heat until charred, 3-4 minutes per side.
Make dressing: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, capers, and parsley.
Serve warm with dressing, roasted peppers, and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season fish with cumin, chili, garlic powder, and salt.
Grill or pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked.
Make slaw: shredded cabbage with lime juice, cilantro, and salt.
Make chipotle crema: mix sour cream, chipotle, and lime.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with fish, slaw, and crema. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Cool.
Place nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread rice leaving 2cm at top.
Add cucumber, avocado, and salmon strips in a line.
Roll tightly using the mat, seal with water.
Cut into 8 pieces with a wet sharp knife.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon in a pot until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Saute onion and celery in bacon fat until soft.
Add potatoes, clam juice, and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in clams and heavy cream. Heat gently.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Serve in bread bowls topped with bacon and fresh chives.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and lime juice for sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp in oil until pink. Push to side.
Scramble eggs in the pan.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss over high heat.
Serve with bean sprouts, peanuts, lime, and green onions.

recipes.title: Moules Frites
instructions: Scrub and debeard mussels. Discard any open ones.
Saute shallots and garlic in butter until soft.
Add white wine and bring to a boil.
Add mussels, cover, and steam for 5 minutes until all open.
Discard any that remain closed. Add cream and parsley.
Serve in large bowls with fries and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
instructions: Season shrimp with cumin, chili, garlic, and lime juice.
Cook in a hot pan for 2 minutes per side.
Make mango salsa: diced mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with shrimp and top with mango salsa and avocado.
Serve with extra lime wedges.

recipes.title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Saute onion, leek, and fennel in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, saffron, and orange peel.
Pour in fish stock and white wine. Bring to a boil.
Add firm fish first, simmer 5 minutes.
Add shellfish and mussels, cook until they open.
Serve with rouille on toasted baguette slices.

recipes.title: Salmon Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Spread avocado on toast.
Top with smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and fresh dill.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Prawn Risotto
instructions: Saute shallot and garlic in butter. Add arborio rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot prawn broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
After 18 minutes, stir in prawns and cook 3 more minutes.
Remove from heat, add butter and Parmesan. Rest 2 minutes.
Serve with lemon zest and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
instructions: Boil eggs for 7 minutes. Cool and halve.
Blanch green beans for 3 minutes. Rinse in cold water.
Cook potatoes until tender. Halve.
Make dressing: Dijon mustard, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and herbs.
Arrange lettuce, tomatoes, olives, tuna, eggs, beans, and potatoes.
Drizzle with dressing and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Calamari Fritti
instructions: Cut squid bodies into rings. Pat dry thoroughly.
Season flour with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Toss squid in seasoned flour, shake off excess.
Deep fry at 180C for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels immediately.
Serve with lemon wedges and aioli or marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Grilled Sea Bass
instructions: Score the fish on both sides 3 times. Season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff cavity with lemon slices, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Brush with olive oil.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes per side.
Make salsa verde: blend parsley, capers, anchovy, garlic, lemon, and olive oil.
Serve with salsa verde and roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until golden.
Add curry powder, cumin, turmeric, and coriander. Cook 2 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes and cook until oil separates.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, and coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with basmati rice and naan.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and water. Knead 10 minutes. Rest 1 hour.
Stretch dough into a thin round on a floured surface.
Spread crushed tomatoes, season with salt and oregano.
Add torn mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil.
Bake at maximum oven temperature (250C) for 10-12 minutes.
Top with fresh basil leaves and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion into chunks.
Add kalamata olives and green bell pepper.
Place a block of feta cheese on top.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Season with dried oregano, salt, and pepper.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Saute shallots and garlic in butter. Add arborio rice, toast 2 minutes.
Add white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm vegetable broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly.
Meanwhile, saute mixed mushrooms until golden.
After 20 minutes, fold in mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan.
Rest 2 minutes and serve with fresh thyme.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomatoes and fresh mozzarella into 1cm rounds.
Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella on a platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil.
Season with flaky sea salt and black pepper.
Finish with a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Slice eggplant, salt, and rest 30 minutes. Pat dry.
Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden. Drain.
Make tomato sauce with garlic, crushed tomatoes, and basil.
Layer eggplant, tomato sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan in a baking dish.
Repeat layers and finish with cheese.
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
instructions: Saute onion and peppers in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until whites are set but yolks still runny.
Garnish with feta, cilantro, and serve with pita bread.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook jumbo pasta shells until al dente. Drain and cool.
Mix ricotta, cooked spinach, egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, and seasoning.
Fill each shell with the ricotta mixture.
Spread tomato sauce in a baking dish. Arrange shells on top.
Cover with remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Bake covered at 180C for 30 minutes, uncover for last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Prepare sauce: soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
Heat wok over high heat until smoking.
Stir-fry broccoli, snap peas, carrots, and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute.
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss until coated.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Cheese Quesadillas
instructions: Saute bell peppers and onion until soft.
Lay tortilla flat, add cheese and vegetables on half.
Fold tortilla over and cook in a dry pan until golden.
Flip and cook other side until crispy.
Cut into wedges and serve with guacamole, salsa, and sour cream.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook 1 minute.
Add red lentils, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are very soft.
Blend partially for a creamy texture.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Tacos
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes with cumin and chili at 200C for 20 minutes.
Cook black beans with garlic, cumin, and salt.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with sweet potato, black beans, and shredded cabbage.
Top with avocado, salsa, and lime juice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Slowly caramelize sliced onions in butter for 45 minutes until deep golden.
Add garlic, thyme, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in white wine and reduce by half.
Add vegetable broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with toasted baguette and Gruyere.
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly.

recipes.title: Spanakopita
instructions: Wilt spinach and squeeze out all excess water.
Mix spinach with crumbled feta, eggs, onion, dill, and nutmeg.
Layer 8 sheets of phyllo in a buttered pan, brushing each with butter.
Spread spinach filling and fold overhanging phyllo over.
Top with 4 more buttered phyllo sheets, tucking edges in.
Score top, brush with butter, and bake at 180C for 45 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add cubed pumpkin and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and coconut milk.
Simmer 25 minutes until pumpkin is very tender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Line a tart tin with shortcrust pastry. Blind bake at 180C for 15 minutes.
Whisk together eggs, cream, and seasoning.
Sprinkle Gruyere and caramelized onions in the pastry case.
Pour egg mixture over.
Bake at 170C for 30-35 minutes until just set with a slight wobble.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, then blend into a smooth puree.
Fry paneer cubes until golden. Set aside.
Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices. Cook until oil separates.
Add spinach puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in paneer and cream. Serve with naan.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
instructions: Make tomato sauce base with garlic, onion, and crushed tomatoes.
Spread in a baking dish.
Thinly slice zucchini, eggplant, and tomatoes.
Arrange slices overlapping in a spiral on top of sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with herbes de Provence.
Cover with parchment and bake at 160C for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook rice with vegetable broth until tender.
Mix rice with sauteed onion, garlic, corn, black beans, and cheese.
Season with cumin, paprika, and salt.
Fill peppers with the rice mixture.
Place in a baking dish, add water at the bottom, and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and peppers in olive oil in a paella pan.
Add smoked paprika and paella rice. Stir to coat.
Pour in saffron-infused vegetable broth. Do not stir.
Add artichoke hearts, green beans, and cherry tomatoes.
Cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until rice absorbs liquid.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
instructions: Roast chickpeas with cumin and paprika at 200C for 20 minutes.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Massage kale with lemon juice and olive oil.
Make tahini dressing with tahini, lemon, garlic, and water.
Assemble bowls with quinoa, kale, roasted chickpeas, avocado, and cucumber.
Drizzle with tahini dressing and sprinkle with seeds.

recipes.title: Vegan Chili
instructions: Saute onion, peppers, and garlic in oil until soft.
Add chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, black beans, and corn.
Simmer 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and lime juice.
Serve with rice, avocado, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegan Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain.
Make sauce: soy sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and lime.
Stir-fry tofu until golden. Push to side.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss over high heat.
Fold in bean sprouts and green onions.
Serve with peanuts, lime, and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Chickpea Tikka Masala
instructions: Saute onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add garam masala, cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook 2 minutes.
Add tomato puree and cook 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach and cook 2 minutes.
Serve with basmati rice and naan.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and chili flakes.
Bring water to a gentle simmer with a splash of vinegar.
Crack eggs into the water and poach for 3 minutes.
Spread avocado on toast and top with poached egg.
Season with salt, pepper, and everything bagel seasoning.

recipes.title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Mash black beans and combine with cooked quinoa, breadcrumbs, and spices.
Add sauteed onion, garlic, and corn. Mix well.
Form into patties and refrigerate 30 minutes.
Cook in a pan with oil for 4 minutes per side until crusted.
Serve in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, and sriracha mayo.

recipes.title: Vegan Tacos al Pastor
instructions: Marinate cauliflower florets in chipotle, achiote, pineapple juice, and spices.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until charred.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with cauliflower, grilled pineapple, and onion.
Top with cilantro, lime, and salsa verde.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bourguignon
instructions: Brown mushrooms and pearl onions in olive oil. Remove.
Saute shallots, carrot, and garlic.
Add tomato paste and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and vegetable stock. Add thyme and bay leaf.
Return mushrooms and onions. Simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Cook yellow lentils with turmeric and salt until very soft.
Make tadka: heat ghee and fry cumin seeds, garlic, and dried chili.
Add chopped onion and cook until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Pour tadka over lentils and stir.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice and roti.

recipes.title: Vegan Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook and season sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Place nori on a bamboo mat, spread rice leaving 2cm at top.
Add avocado, cucumber, carrot, and pickled radish.
Roll tightly and seal with water.
Cut into 8 pieces.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Falafel with Pita
instructions: Blend soaked chickpeas with onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, and parsley.
Season and form into small balls or patties.
Deep fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Make tahini sauce with tahini, lemon, garlic, and water.
Serve in warm pita with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and tahini.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Tart
instructions: Roast zucchini, peppers, eggplant, and cherry tomatoes with olive oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Line a tart tin with puff pastry. Prick with a fork.
Spread creme fraiche mixed with garlic and herbs.
Arrange roasted vegetables and crumbled goat cheese on top.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until pastry is golden.
Serve warm with dressed salad greens.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble
instructions: Press firm tofu to remove excess water. Crumble roughly.
Saute bell pepper and onion in oil for 3 minutes.
Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, and black salt.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve on toast with avocado and hot sauce.

recipes.title: Caprese Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook fusilli until al dente. Rinse under cold water.
Halve cherry tomatoes and tear mozzarella into pieces.
Mix pasta with tomatoes, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
Dress with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Let marinate 15 minutes before serving.
Top with pine nuts if desired.

recipes.title: Corn and Black Bean Salad
instructions: Char corn on a grill or dry pan until slightly blackened.
Mix corn with black beans, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and jalapeno.
Make dressing: lime juice, olive oil, cumin, and salt.
Toss with dressing and fresh cilantro.
Add diced avocado just before serving.
Serve as a side or with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Vegan Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate cubed tofu in coconut yogurt and spices. Pan-fry until golden.
Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add garam masala, cumin, and paprika. Cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and add tofu.
Simmer 10 minutes and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Gazpacho
instructions: Blend ripe tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, and garlic until smooth.
Add olive oil, sherry vinegar, salt, and cumin.
Blend with stale bread for thickness.
Strain through a sieve for smooth texture.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Serve cold with diced vegetable garnish and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Roast zucchini, eggplant, and peppers with olive oil.
Make tomato sauce with garlic, crushed tomatoes, and basil.
Make bechamel with butter, flour, and milk.
Layer lasagna sheets, tomato sauce, roasted vegetables, ricotta, and bechamel.
Top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake covered at 180C for 35 minutes, uncover for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Tofu
instructions: Simmer vegetable broth with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add mushrooms, tofu, and Thai chili.
Season with soy sauce, lime juice, and sugar.
Remove aromatic stems before serving.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, zucchini, and green beans. Cook 3 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, cannellini beans, and vegetable broth.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Add small pasta and cook until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh basil. Serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Mujaddara
instructions: Cook lentils in water with cumin and turmeric until just tender.
Add rice and cook until both are done.
Caramelize sliced onions in olive oil until deep golden brown.
Mix lentils and rice together and season well.
Top with crispy caramelized onions.
Serve with yogurt and cucumber salad.

recipes.title: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and brush with olive oil.
Make filling: saute mushroom stems, spinach, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Mix with ricotta, Parmesan, and herbs.
Fill mushroom caps with the mixture.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Tagine
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil with ras el hanout.
Add sweet potato, carrot, and zucchini. Coat in spices.
Add canned tomatoes, chickpeas, and vegetable broth.
Simmer covered for 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in preserved lemon and olives.
Serve with couscous and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Fried Rice
instructions: Pulse cauliflower florets in a food processor until rice-sized.
Heat wok over high heat. Stir-fry garlic and ginger.
Add frozen peas, carrots, and corn. Cook 3 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burrito
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes with cumin and chili until tender.
Season black beans with garlic, cumin, and lime.
Cook rice and season with cilantro and lime.
Warm large flour tortillas.
Layer rice, beans, sweet potato, avocado, and salsa.
Fold into burritos and serve with extra salsa.

recipes.title: Saag Aloo
instructions: Boil potato cubes until just tender. Drain.
Fry cumin seeds and mustard seeds in oil until popping.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until golden.
Add turmeric, coriander, and chili. Cook 1 minute.
Add potatoes and toss to coat. Cook 5 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted. Season and serve.

recipes.title: Watermelon Feta Salad
instructions: Cut watermelon into cubes or triangles.
Arrange on a platter with crumbled feta.
Scatter fresh mint leaves and thinly sliced red onion.
Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice.
Season with black pepper and flaky salt.
Serve immediately as a refreshing side.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
instructions: Grate zucchini, salt, and squeeze out all excess moisture.
Mix with eggs, flour, feta, dill, and green onions.
Season with salt and pepper.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil over medium heat until golden, 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with tzatziki and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pea and Mint Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add frozen peas and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Add fresh mint and blend until smooth.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Serve hot or cold with a swirl of coconut cream.

recipes.title: Banana Blossom Fish and Chips
instructions: Drain and rinse banana blossom. Pat dry and season with nori, lemon, and fish-free seasoning.
Make beer batter with flour, baking powder, and cold beer.
Coat banana blossom pieces in batter.
Deep fry at 180C for 4-5 minutes until golden.
Serve with thick-cut chips, mushy peas, and tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 175C. Grease and flour two 9-inch round pans.
Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Add eggs, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla. Beat until smooth.
Stir in boiling water — batter will be thin.
Pour into pans and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then frost with chocolate buttercream.

recipes.title: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk egg yolks and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in mascarpone until smooth.
Whip cream to soft peaks and fold into mascarpone mixture.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in cold espresso mixed with Marsala.
Layer soaked ladyfingers and cream in a dish.
Dust generously with cocoa powder and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Creme Brulee
instructions: Heat cream with vanilla bean until just simmering.
Whisk egg yolks and sugar until pale.
Slowly pour hot cream into egg mixture, whisking constantly.
Strain into ramekins and place in a water bath.
Bake at 150C for 35-40 minutes until set with a slight wobble.
Chill completely, then sprinkle sugar and torch until caramelized.

recipes.title: New York Cheesecake
instructions: Crush graham crackers and mix with butter. Press into springform pan.
Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar, vanilla, and sour cream.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing on low speed.
Pour over crust and bake at 160C for 60-70 minutes.
Turn oven off and let cool inside for 1 hour with door ajar.
Chill overnight before serving with berry compote.

recipes.title: French Macarons
instructions: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar together twice.
Make Italian meringue: whip egg whites to soft peaks, then pour in hot sugar syrup.
Fold meringue into almond mixture using macaronage technique until batter flows like lava.
Pipe 3cm rounds onto parchment. Bang tray to release bubbles. Rest 30-60 minutes.
Bake at 150C for 13-15 minutes. Cool completely.
Sandwich with buttercream or ganache filling.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
instructions: Make pie dough: blend flour, butter, and salt. Add ice water until dough forms. Chill 1 hour.
Peel and slice apples. Toss with sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and flour.
Roll out half the dough and line a pie dish.
Fill with apple mixture and dot with butter.
Cover with lattice or full top crust. Crimp edges and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200C for 50-55 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter together. Cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, and sugar until light.
Fold chocolate mixture into eggs. Stir in flour.
Butter and flour 4 ramekins. Fill three-quarters full.
Bake at 220C for 10-12 minutes — edges firm, center still wobbly.
Rest 1 minute, then invert onto plates. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Baklava
instructions: Make syrup: simmer sugar, water, honey, and lemon until slightly thickened. Cool.
Mix walnuts and pistachios with cinnamon and sugar.
Layer 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter.
Spread nut mixture and top with 8 more buttered phyllo sheets.
Score diamond shapes through top layers. Bake at 175C for 40-45 minutes until golden.
Pour cold syrup over hot baklava. Cool completely before serving.

recipes.title: Panna Cotta
instructions: Bloom gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes.
Heat cream, sugar, and vanilla until sugar dissolves. Do not boil.
Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved.
Pour into lightly oiled ramekins or glasses.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Serve with fresh berry coulis or caramel sauce.

recipes.title: Churros with Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Bring water, butter, and salt to a boil. Add flour all at once and stir vigorously.
Cook until dough pulls away from sides. Cool slightly.
Beat in eggs one at a time until smooth.
Pipe through a star tip into hot oil. Fry until golden, 3-4 minutes.
Roll in cinnamon sugar immediately.
Make chocolate sauce: heat cream and pour over chopped chocolate. Stir until smooth.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Make shortcake biscuits: mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Cut in butter.
Add cream until dough just comes together. Pat out and cut rounds.
Bake at 200C for 18-20 minutes until golden.
Macerate sliced strawberries with sugar for 30 minutes.
Whip heavy cream with sugar and vanilla to soft peaks.
Split biscuits, fill with cream and strawberries. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mango Sorbet
instructions: Blend ripe mango flesh until completely smooth.
Make simple syrup: boil sugar and water for 2 minutes. Cool.
Mix mango puree with syrup and lime juice.
Churn in an ice cream machine for 20-25 minutes.
Transfer to a container and freeze for 2 hours.
Serve scooped with fresh mint and lime zest.

recipes.title: Banana Foster
instructions: Melt butter in a pan. Add brown sugar and cinnamon.
Add banana liqueur and cook 1 minute.
Add halved bananas and coat in sauce.
Pour in rum and carefully flambee.
Cook until flames subside and sauce thickens.
Serve immediately over vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Profiteroles
instructions: Make choux pastry: boil water and butter. Add flour, stir vigorously.
Beat in eggs one at a time until glossy and smooth.
Pipe small mounds onto baking sheet. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Cool completely, then fill with whipped cream using a piping bag.
Make chocolate sauce and pour over just before serving.

recipes.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
instructions: Soak chopped dates in boiling water with baking soda for 10 minutes.
Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour and date mixture.
Pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 180C for 30-35 minutes.
Make toffee sauce: boil butter, brown sugar, and cream until thickened.
Pour hot sauce over pudding and serve with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Mochi Ice Cream
instructions: Mix mochiko rice flour, sugar, and water in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave 2 minutes, stir, microwave 1 more minute. Should be stretchy.
Dust work surface with cornstarch. Turn out dough and flatten.
Scoop ice cream into small balls and freeze solid.
Wrap each ice cream ball in a piece of mochi dough.
Pinch to seal and freeze until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: Make caramel: cook sugar and butter in an oven-safe pan until amber.
Arrange apple halves cut side up tightly in the caramel.
Cook on stovetop for 10 minutes until apples soften slightly.
Drape puff pastry over apples, tucking edges in.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until pastry is golden.
Rest 5 minutes, then carefully invert onto a plate. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Pavlova
instructions: Whip egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually add sugar, beating until glossy.
Fold in cornstarch and vinegar.
Spread onto parchment in a circle, creating a slight indent in center.
Bake at 120C for 1.5 hours. Turn oven off and leave inside to cool.
Top with whipped cream and fresh seasonal fruits.
Serve immediately once assembled.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter. Cool to room temperature.
Separate eggs. Beat yolks with sugar until pale.
Fold chocolate into yolk mixture.
Whip cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Whip egg whites to stiff peaks and gently fold into chocolate mixture.
Divide into glasses and chill at least 2 hours. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Tres Leches Cake
instructions: Bake a light sponge cake in a 9x13 pan at 175C for 25-30 minutes.
Poke holes all over the warm cake with a fork.
Mix sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, and heavy cream.
Pour milk mixture slowly over warm cake. Refrigerate 4 hours.
Frost with sweetened whipped cream.
Serve chilled, garnished with cinnamon and fresh berries.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun
instructions: Mix milk powder, flour, baking powder, and ghee until crumbly.
Add warm milk gradually to form a soft dough. Rest 10 minutes.
Make sugar syrup with rose water and cardamom. Keep warm.
Roll dough into small smooth balls.
Deep fry on low heat until deep golden brown, turning constantly.
Soak in warm syrup for at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cannoli
instructions: Make dough with flour, sugar, butter, Marsala, and egg. Rest 1 hour.
Roll thin and cut circles. Wrap around metal tubes.
Deep fry at 180C until golden and crispy. Cool before removing tubes.
Make filling: beat ricotta with powdered sugar, chocolate chips, and orange zest.
Pipe filling into shells just before serving.
Dust with powdered sugar and garnish ends with pistachios.

recipes.title: Lemon Tart
instructions: Make shortcrust pastry. Chill and blind bake at 180C for 15 minutes.
Whisk eggs, sugar, lemon juice, and zest.
Stir in melted butter.
Pour into pre-baked tart shell.
Bake at 160C for 20 minutes until just set.
Cool completely and dust with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash 3 very ripe bananas until smooth.
Mix in melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda, and salt. Stir until just combined.
Fold in optional walnuts or chocolate chips.
Pour into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 175C for 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Waffles with Berries
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Mix eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just smooth.
Preheat and grease waffle iron.
Cook waffles until golden and crispy, about 4-5 minutes each.
Serve with fresh berries, maple syrup, and whipped cream.

recipes.title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Make Hollandaise: whisk egg yolks with lemon juice over a double boiler.
Slowly drizzle in melted butter while whisking until thick and creamy.
Season with salt, cayenne, and lemon. Keep warm.
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toast English muffins. Top with Canadian bacon.
Place poached egg on top and spoon Hollandaise generously. Garnish with paprika.

recipes.title: French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cream, vanilla, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Soak thick bread slices in the egg mixture for 30 seconds per side.
Cook in butter over medium heat until golden, 2-3 minutes per side.
Keep warm in a low oven while cooking remaining slices.
Serve with maple syrup, powdered sugar, and fresh berries.

recipes.title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla separately.
Pour wet into dry and mix until just combined — lumps are fine.
Heat a greased pan over medium heat.
Pour 60ml batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip, cook 1 more minute.
Serve stacked with maple syrup, butter, and fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Full English Breakfast
instructions: Grill bacon and sausages until cooked through.
Fry or scramble eggs to your liking.
Grill halved tomatoes and mushrooms with butter.
Heat baked beans in a small saucepan.
Toast bread or fry bread in bacon fat.
Arrange everything on warm plates and serve with brown sauce and tea.

recipes.title: Acai Bowl
instructions: Blend frozen acai packets with banana and a splash of almond milk until thick.
Pour into bowls — should be thicker than a smoothie.
Top with granola, sliced banana, and fresh berries.
Add honey, coconut flakes, and chia seeds.
Finish with a drizzle of nut butter.
Serve immediately before it melts.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine rolled oats, chia seeds, and milk in a jar.
Add maple syrup and vanilla. Stir well.
Seal and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
In the morning, stir and add more milk if too thick.
Top with fresh fruit, nut butter, and granola.
Eat cold or warm briefly in the microwave.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado Eggs
instructions: Toast sourdough or grain bread until golden.
Smash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and chili flakes.
Fry eggs sunny side up in butter.
Spread avocado thickly on toast.
Top with fried egg, cherry tomatoes, and microgreens.
Season with flaky salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook breakfast sausage and crumble. Set aside.
Scramble eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Warm black beans with cumin and garlic.
Warm flour tortillas in a dry pan.
Layer eggs, sausage, beans, cheese, salsa, and avocado on tortilla.
Fold into a burrito and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer Greek yogurt in the bottom of two glasses or bowls.
Add a layer of granola.
Add fresh mixed berries.
Repeat layers.
Drizzle with honey.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Shakshuka Breakfast
instructions: Saute onion and peppers in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili. Cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Create wells and crack eggs into the sauce.
Cover and cook until whites are set, yolks still runny.
Garnish with feta and fresh herbs. Serve with pita.

recipes.title: Bircher Muesli
instructions: Combine oats, apple juice, and yogurt. Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, grate apple directly into the oats.
Add lemon juice, honey, and cinnamon. Mix well.
Fold in toasted nuts and dried fruits.
Serve topped with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles
instructions: Make or use store-bought salsa verde or roja.
Fry corn tortilla strips until crispy.
Simmer tortilla chips in warm salsa for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Top with fried eggs, crumbled queso fresco, and sour cream.
Garnish with sliced onion, cilantro, and avocado.
Serve immediately before chips get too soggy.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Bagel
instructions: Slice bagels in half and toast until golden.
Mix cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.
Spread cream cheese generously on both halves.
Layer smoked salmon on the bottom half.
Add capers, thinly sliced red onion, and cucumber.
Top with the other half or serve open-faced with dill.

recipes.title: Congee
instructions: Rinse rice and add to a large pot with chicken broth (1:10 ratio).
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper.
Serve topped with shredded chicken, century egg, and green onion.
Garnish with fried shallots and fresh ginger.

recipes.title: Crepes Suzette
instructions: Make crepe batter: blend flour, eggs, milk, butter, and salt until smooth. Rest 30 minutes.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan. Stack and set aside.
Make orange butter sauce: melt butter with orange juice, zest, and sugar.
Fold crepes into quarters and heat in the orange sauce.
Add Grand Marnier and flambee.
Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Granola
instructions: Mix oats, nuts, seeds, coconut, and spices in a large bowl.
Whisk together oil, honey or maple syrup, and vanilla.
Pour over oat mixture and toss until well coated.
Spread on a baking sheet in an even layer.
Bake at 160C for 25-30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
Cool completely — it crisps as it cools. Stir in dried fruit.

recipes.title: Turkish Breakfast Spread
instructions: Scramble eggs with tomatoes, peppers, and onion (menemen style).
Arrange small bowls of olives, white cheese, cucumber, and tomato.
Toast sesame simit or bread.
Add honey, clotted cream, and fruit jam to the spread.
Brew strong black tea.
Serve everything together family style.

recipes.title: Chia Pudding
instructions: Combine chia seeds and coconut milk in a jar. Stir well.
Add maple syrup and vanilla. Mix again.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight until thick and set.
Stir before serving and add extra milk if needed.
Top with fresh mango, berries, and toasted coconut.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
instructions: Make ranchero sauce: blend roasted tomatoes, chipotle, garlic, and onion.
Simmer sauce for 10 minutes until thickened.
Fry corn tortillas briefly in oil until crispy.
Fry eggs sunny side up.
Place egg on tortilla and spoon sauce over.
Top with black beans, avocado, queso fresco, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Protein Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend frozen banana, berries, Greek yogurt, and protein powder until very thick.
Add minimal liquid — should be thicker than a regular smoothie.
Pour into a bowl.
Arrange toppings: sliced banana, granola, seeds, and nut butter.
Add fresh berries and a drizzle of honey.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Mix oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Whisk eggs, milk, maple syrup, butter, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients.
Fold in blueberries and sliced banana.
Pour into a greased baking dish.
Bake at 180C for 35-40 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Croque Madame
instructions: Make bechamel: melt butter, add flour, then milk. Cook until thick.
Stir in Gruyere and season with nutmeg.
Spread bechamel on bread slices. Add ham and Gruyere.
Top with another slice of bread.
Spread bechamel on top and more cheese.
Grill under broiler until golden. Top with a fried egg to make it a Madame.

recipes.title: Dim Sum Har Gow
instructions: Mix shrimp filling with bamboo shoots, sesame oil, soy sauce, and cornstarch.
Make wrapper dough with wheat starch and boiling water. Knead smooth.
Roll thin and cut circles. Place filling in center.
Pleat and fold to seal into half-moon shapes.
Steam over high heat for 8-10 minutes.
Serve with soy sauce, chili oil, and hot Chinese tea.

recipes.title: Breakfast Hash
instructions: Dice potatoes and parboil for 5 minutes. Drain.
Cook diced onion and peppers in oil until soft.
Add potatoes and cook undisturbed until crispy on one side.
Flip and add corned beef or sausage.
Create wells and crack eggs in. Cover and cook to desired doneness.
Season and garnish with hot sauce and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Matcha Latte Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats in oat milk until creamy.
Whisk matcha powder with a little hot water until smooth.
Stir matcha into cooked oats with maple syrup.
Pour into bowls and top with sliced banana.
Add white sesame seeds, coconut flakes, and a drizzle of honey.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Tacos al Pastor
instructions: Marinate pork in achiote paste, chipotle, pineapple juice, garlic, and spices for 4 hours.
Grill or pan-fry pork slices until charred and cooked through.
Grill pineapple slices until caramelized.
Warm corn tortillas on a comal.
Fill tortillas with pork and pineapple.
Top with chopped onion, cilantro, and salsa verde.

recipes.title: Pozole Rojo
instructions: Simmer pork shoulder in water with onion, garlic, and bay leaves for 1.5 hours.
Toast and soak dried guajillo and ancho chiles. Blend with garlic and broth.
Strain chile sauce into the pork broth.
Add hominy and simmer 30 more minutes.
Shred the pork and return to the pot.
Serve with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, and tostadas.

recipes.title: Chiles en Nogada
instructions: Roast and peel poblano chiles. Make a slit and remove seeds.
Make picadillo: cook ground pork with onion, garlic, tomatoes, peaches, pears, almonds, and raisins.
Season with cinnamon, cloves, and pepper. Stuff into chiles.
Make walnut sauce: blend walnuts, cream cheese, sour cream, and sherry.
Pour sauce over stuffed chiles.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Enchiladas Verdes
instructions: Make salsa verde: blend roasted tomatillos, jalapenos, garlic, and cilantro.
Simmer sauce with chicken broth for 10 minutes.
Cook and shred chicken breast.
Dip corn tortillas in warm oil briefly, then in the salsa.
Fill with chicken and roll up in a baking dish.
Cover with remaining salsa, crema, and queso fresco. Bake at 180C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mole Negro con Pollo
instructions: Toast dried chiles, spices, and sesame seeds separately.
Fry tomatoes, onion, garlic, and plantain.
Blend everything with dark chocolate and chicken broth.
Fry the paste in lard until fragrant, about 15 minutes.
Add more broth and simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Add cooked chicken pieces and simmer 20 more minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Tamales de Rajas
instructions: Soak corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes.
Beat lard until fluffy. Add masa harina, broth, baking powder, and salt.
Make rajas filling: roast and peel poblanos, slice with onion and cheese.
Spread masa on corn husks, add filling, and fold.
Steam standing upright for 75-90 minutes.
Serve with salsa and crema.

recipes.title: Sopa de Lima
instructions: Simmer chicken with onion, garlic, and tomato in broth for 25 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to pot.
Add lime juice and sliced limes. Simmer 5 minutes.
Fry tortilla strips until crispy.
Ladle soup into bowls.
Top with tortilla strips, avocado, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Carnitas
instructions: Cut pork into large chunks. Season with salt, cumin, and oregano.
Place in a Dutch oven with orange juice, lime, garlic, and bay leaves.
Cook uncovered on medium heat for 2 hours, turning occasionally.
Once liquid evaporates, fry in the rendered fat until crispy.
Shred with two forks.
Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, onion, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Tlayuda
instructions: Toast large corn tortillas on a comal until crispy.
Spread black bean paste over each tortilla.
Top with asiento (pork fat) or olive oil.
Add Oaxaca cheese and your choice of toppings.
Grill or broil until cheese melts.
Top with shredded cabbage, avocado, salsa, and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Cochinita Pibil
instructions: Mix achiote paste with sour orange juice, garlic, cumin, and oregano.
Rub all over pork shoulder. Marinate overnight.
Wrap in banana leaves and place in a roasting pan.
Slow roast at 150C for 4 hours until fall-apart tender.
Shred the meat and mix with pan juices.
Serve in tortillas with pickled red onions and habanero salsa.

recipes.title: Esquites
instructions: Cut corn kernels off the cob.
Saute with butter, epazote or cilantro, and chile serrano.
Cook until slightly charred.
Serve in cups with mayonnaise, lime juice, and chile powder.
Top with cotija cheese and more lime.
Eat with a spoon as a street food snack.

recipes.title: Birria Tacos
instructions: Toast and soak dried chiles. Blend with tomatoes, garlic, and spices.
Season beef short ribs and goat with chile sauce.
Slow braise covered at 160C for 3 hours until very tender.
Reserve the consomme broth.
Dip corn tortillas in the fat from the broth and griddle until crispy.
Fill with shredded meat and cheese. Serve with consomme for dipping.

recipes.title: Elote Callejero
instructions: Grill whole corn cobs over high heat until charred on all sides.
Immediately spread with mayonnaise.
Sprinkle generously with cotija cheese.
Dust with chile powder and tajin.
Squeeze lime over everything.
Eat immediately while hot.

recipes.title: Sopa de Tortilla
instructions: Blend roasted tomatoes, garlic, onion, and chile pasilla.
Fry the sauce in oil until dark and fragrant.
Add chicken broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Fry tortilla strips until crispy.
Serve soup in bowls with tortilla strips.
Top with avocado, crema, cheese, and pasilla strips.

recipes.title: Flautas de Pollo
instructions: Shred cooked chicken and season with salt, cumin, and garlic.
Roll tightly in corn tortillas and secure with a toothpick.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy all around.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce with crema and salsa.
Top with guacamole and cotija cheese.

recipes.title: Ramen
instructions: Make broth: simmer pork bones with ginger, garlic, and scallions for 4 hours.
Make tare: mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar.
Cook ramen noodles according to package. Drain.
Prepare toppings: soft-boiled eggs, chashu pork, nori, corn, and bamboo shoots.
Add tare to bowls, pour hot broth over.
Add noodles and arrange toppings. Serve with sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.title: Dim Sum Siu Mai
instructions: Mix shrimp, pork, bamboo shoots, mushrooms, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Season with ginger, garlic, and white pepper.
Place a round wonton wrapper in your palm.
Add filling and shape into an open cylinder, pleating the sides.
Top with fish roe or carrot.
Steam over high heat for 12-15 minutes. Serve with soy dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Curry
instructions: Fry massaman curry paste in coconut milk until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and coat in the paste.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and chicken broth.
Add potatoes, onion, and roasted peanuts.
Simmer 30 minutes until chicken and potatoes are tender.
Season with fish sauce, tamarind, and palm sugar. Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Bibimbap
instructions: Cook each vegetable separately: spinach, bean sprouts, carrots, and zucchini.
Season each with sesame oil, garlic, and salt.
Make gochujang sauce: mix paste with sesame oil, sugar, and vinegar.
Divide hot rice into stone bowls or regular bowls.
Arrange vegetables, beef, and a fried egg on top.
Add gochujang sauce and mix vigorously before eating.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, cornstarch, and Shaoxing wine.
Make sauce: soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch.
Stir-fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until done.
Add garlic, ginger, and the sauce. Toss.
Add roasted peanuts and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls
instructions: Cook shrimp and pork. Slice shrimp in half lengthwise.
