Soften rice paper in warm water for 15 seconds.
Lay on a damp surface and add lettuce, vermicelli, herbs, shrimp, and pork.
Fold sides in and roll tightly.
Make dipping sauce: hoisin with peanut butter, lime, and chili.
Serve immediately with dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng
instructions: Make kecap manis if needed: simmer soy sauce with palm sugar.
Blend shallots, garlic, chilies, and shrimp paste.
Stir-fry paste in oil until fragrant.
Add cold day-old rice, breaking up clumps.
Season with kecap manis and soy sauce.
Top with fried egg, cucumber, tomato, and prawn crackers.

recipes.title: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Boil water or broth with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves.
Add mushrooms and tomatoes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar.
Add Thai chilies for heat.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
instructions: Stir-fry ground pork until cooked. Add doubanjiang and cook until fragrant.
Add garlic, ginger, and fermented black beans.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Gently add silken tofu cubes.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Finish with Sichuan peppercorn oil, green onions, and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Laksa
instructions: Blend shallots, lemongrass, chilies, galangal, and turmeric into laksa paste.
Fry paste in oil until very fragrant.
Add coconut milk and chicken broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add tofu puffs, shrimp, and fish cakes.
Cook rice noodles separately.
Serve noodles in broth with bean sprouts, hard-boiled egg, and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Gyoza
instructions: Mix ground pork with cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Place filling in center of gyoza wrappers.
Fold and pleat edges to seal tightly.
Pan-fry flat side down in oil over medium-high until golden.
Add water, cover immediately and steam 5 minutes.
Uncover and fry until crispy again. Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Pho Ga
instructions: Char onion and ginger over flame until blackened.
Simmer whole chicken with charred aromatics, star anise, cinnamon, and cloves.
After 1.5 hours, remove chicken and shred the meat.
Strain broth and season with fish sauce and salt.
Cook rice noodles, drain, and divide into bowls.
Top with shredded chicken and ladle hot broth over. Serve with herbs and lime.

recipes.title: Peking Duck
instructions: Air dry the duck uncovered in the fridge for 24-48 hours.
Brush with maltose and soy glaze. Air dry 2 more hours.
Roast at 200C breast side up for 1 hour until skin is lacquered and crispy.
Rest 15 minutes before carving.
Slice crispy skin and meat separately.
Serve with Mandarin pancakes, hoisin, cucumber, and green onion.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
instructions: Soak glutinous rice in water for 2 hours. Drain.
Steam rice for 25 minutes until cooked.
Heat coconut milk with sugar and salt until sugar dissolves.
Pour two thirds of coconut sauce over hot rice. Cover and rest 20 minutes.
Peel and slice ripe mangoes.
Serve rice with mango and remaining coconut sauce drizzled over.

recipes.title: Banh Mi
instructions: Marinate pork in lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, and sugar. Grill until caramelized.
Quick pickle daikon and carrots in vinegar and sugar for 30 minutes.
Slice baguettes and spread with mayonnaise and pate.
Layer with pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber, and jalapeno.
Add fresh cilantro and a drizzle of sriracha.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Katsu Curry
instructions: Make curry sauce: saute onion, add Japanese curry roux blocks and water.
Simmer with carrots and potatoes until tender.
Pound chicken breasts thin. Coat in flour, egg, then panko.
Deep fry at 170C for 5-6 minutes until golden.
Slice cutlets and serve over steamed rice.
Pour curry sauce alongside and garnish with pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Green Papaya Salad
instructions: Shred green papaya using a mandoline or box grater.
Pound garlic and chilies in a mortar.
Add cherry tomatoes and long beans. Pound lightly.
Add papaya and dress with fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, and dried shrimp.
Toss everything together, adjusting seasoning.
Serve with sticky rice and grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Char Siu Pork
instructions: Mix hoisin, soy sauce, honey, Shaoxing wine, five spice, and red food coloring.
Marinate pork shoulder strips for at least 4 hours.
Roast at 200C for 25 minutes, basting every 10 minutes.
Broil for 5 minutes until caramelized and slightly charred.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve over rice with steamed bok choy and char siu sauce.

recipes.title: Miso Soup
instructions: Make dashi: steep kombu in cold water for 30 minutes, heat until just simmering.
Add bonito flakes, steep 5 minutes, then strain.
Bring dashi to a gentle simmer.
Dissolve miso paste in a ladle of dashi, then stir into the pot.
Add tofu cubes and wakame seaweed.
Serve immediately garnished with green onion.

recipes.title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
instructions: Poach whole chicken in water with ginger and scallions for 45 minutes.
Remove chicken, rub skin with sesame oil, and rest.
Cook rice in the poaching broth with garlic and ginger.
Make dipping sauces: chili ginger sauce and dark soy.
Slice chicken and arrange over rice.
Serve with cucumber, soup, and dipping sauces.

recipes.title: Kimchi Jjigae
instructions: Stir-fry pork belly with sesame oil until slightly caramelized.
Add well-fermented kimchi and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Pour in anchovy broth and bring to a boil.
Add tofu and gochugaru. Simmer 20 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and fish sauce.
Serve bubbling hot with steamed rice and banchan.

recipes.title: Rendang Ayam
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, chilies, lemongrass, and galangal into a paste.
Fry paste until fragrant and darkened.
Add chicken pieces and coat in paste.
Pour in coconut milk with kaffir lime leaves and turmeric.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Cook until sauce is almost dry and chicken is dark. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki
instructions: Mix flour, dashi broth, eggs, and shredded cabbage into a thick batter.
Add shrimp, pork belly strips, and green onion.
Cook in oil in a round shape, medium heat, 5 minutes per side.
Top with okonomiyaki sauce and kewpie mayo in a zigzag pattern.
Sprinkle with bonito flakes and aonori.
Serve immediately as the bonito flakes dance from the heat.

recipes.title: Beef Pho
instructions: Char onion and ginger under broiler until blackened.
Simmer beef bones with spices for 3 hours. Strain and season broth.
Slice beef sirloin paper thin. It will cook in the hot broth.
Cook rice noodles and divide into bowls.
Add raw beef slices on top of noodles.
Ladle boiling broth over to cook the beef. Serve with herbs and lime.

recipes.title: Adobo Chicken
instructions: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and black pepper.
Add chicken and marinate 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer 30 minutes.
Remove chicken and pan-fry in oil until golden and crispy.
Reduce the braising liquid until syrupy.
Pour sauce over crispy chicken and serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Takoyaki
instructions: Make batter: mix flour, dashi broth, eggs, soy sauce, and ginger.
Heat takoyaki pan and oil each hole.
Fill each hole with batter, add octopus, green onion, and tempura bits.
When batter sets on edges, rotate each ball 90 degrees with a skewer.
Keep rotating until perfectly round and golden.
Top with takoyaki sauce, mayo, bonito flakes, and aonori.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Score chicken pieces deeply. Rub with lemon juice and salt. Rest 30 minutes.
Mix yogurt with tandoori masala, garlic, ginger, and red food coloring.
Coat chicken thoroughly and marinate overnight.
Cook in a very hot oven at 230C or under broiler for 25-30 minutes.
Char slightly for authentic flavor.
Serve with naan, mint chutney, sliced onions, and lime.

recipes.title: Pad See Ew
instructions: Soak wide rice noodles in warm water until pliable. Drain.
Make sauce: dark soy, oyster sauce, light soy, and sugar.
Stir-fry chicken in very hot wok until cooked. Set aside.
Add noodles and spread in single layer. Let char slightly without stirring.
Scramble eggs into the noodles.
Add Chinese broccoli and sauce. Toss and serve with white pepper.

recipes.title: Dandan Noodles
instructions: Make sauce: tahini, chili oil, soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame paste, garlic.
Brown ground pork with doubanjiang and preserved vegetables.
Cook noodles until just tender. Reserve pasta water.
Add a spoon of sauce to each bowl.
Top with noodles and pork mixture.
Garnish with peanuts, green onions, and more chili oil.

recipes.title: Khao Pad
instructions: Use day-old cold jasmine rice for best results.
Stir-fry garlic in a very hot wok with oil.
Add chicken or shrimp and cook until done.
Push to the side, scramble eggs.
Add rice and stir-fry vigorously over high heat.
Season with fish sauce, oyster sauce, and white pepper. Serve with lime and cucumber.

recipes.title: Samosa
instructions: Make dough with flour, ajwain, oil, and water. Rest 30 minutes.
Make filling: saute onion with spices, add cooked peas and mashed potato.
Roll dough thin and cut into semicircles.
Fill each semicircle and fold into a cone shape, sealing with water.
Deep fry at 160C for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy.
Serve with mint chutney and tamarind sauce.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon
instructions: Cook udon noodles. Drain and set aside.
Stir-fry pork belly or shrimp in sesame oil.
Add cabbage, mushrooms, and carrots. Cook 3 minutes.
Add udon noodles and sauce (soy sauce, mirin, oyster sauce).
Toss everything over high heat until sauce coats noodles.
Serve with pickled ginger, bonito flakes, and togarashi.

recipes.title: Butter Naan
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, yogurt, and oil. Knead 10 minutes.
Rest in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Divide into 8 balls. Roll out to an oval shape.
Cook on a very hot cast iron pan or griddle for 2 minutes per side.
Brush generously with garlic butter immediately.
Serve hot with curry or dal.

recipes.title: Chicken Karaage
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces.
Marinate in soy sauce, sake, ginger, and garlic for 30 minutes.
Coat in potato starch.
Deep fry at 160C for 4 minutes. Rest 3 minutes.
Fry again at 180C for 2 minutes until extra crispy.
Serve with lemon, kewpie mayo, and shredded cabbage.

recipes.title: Bibim Guksu
instructions: Cook thin wheat noodles. Rinse under cold water until completely cold.
Make sauce: gochujang, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and garlic.
Prepare toppings: julienned cucumber, shredded carrot, sliced kimchi.
Toss cold noodles with the spicy sauce.
Divide into bowls and arrange toppings.
Garnish with sesame seeds and a soft-boiled egg.

recipes.title: Hummus
instructions: Drain canned chickpeas, reserving the liquid.
Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and ice water until ultra smooth.
Season generously with salt and cumin.
Spread in a bowl creating a well in the center.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika and sumac.
Serve with warm pita and crudites.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
instructions: Soak bulgur wheat in boiling water for 20 minutes. Drain and cool.
Finely chop a large amount of fresh parsley and mint.
Dice tomatoes and green onions finely.
Combine everything with bulgur.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and allspice.
Rest 30 minutes for flavors to meld. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta
instructions: Mix ground lamb with grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and parsley.
Knead well for 2 minutes until sticky.
Shape onto skewers into elongated cylinders.
Grill over high heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
Make yogurt sauce with yogurt, mint, garlic, and lemon.
Serve with flatbread, salad, and yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush
instructions: Char eggplants directly over gas flame or under broiler until completely blackened.
Place in a colander and cool for 20 minutes.
Peel off blackened skin and squeeze out excess liquid.
Chop flesh roughly and mix with tahini, lemon, garlic, and salt.
Spread in a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Persian Lamb Stew (Ghormeh Sabzi)
instructions: Fry a large amount of chopped parsley, fenugreek, and dried limes until very dark.
Brown lamb chunks in oil. Add onion and turmeric.
Add the fried herb mixture, kidney beans, and dried limes.
Pour in broth and simmer covered for 2 hours.
Adjust seasoning with salt and lemon.
Serve with Persian saffron rice.

recipes.title: Manakish
instructions: Make dough with flour, yeast, olive oil, and salt. Rest 1 hour.
Mix dried zaatar with olive oil to make a paste.
Divide dough into balls and flatten into rounds.
Spread zaatar paste generously on each round.
Bake at 220C for 8-10 minutes until edges are golden.
Serve immediately with olives, tomatoes, and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Fattoush
instructions: Toast or fry pita bread until crispy. Break into pieces.
Chop romaine, tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, and green onions.
Make dressing: lemon juice, olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, and garlic.
Toss vegetables with dressing.
Add pita chips just before serving.
Garnish with fresh mint and extra sumac.

recipes.title: Lamb Biryani
instructions: Marinate lamb in yogurt, biryani spices, and fried onions for 2 hours.
Cook lamb until almost done in a heavy pot.
Parboil basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer rice over lamb. Add saffron milk, fried onions, and ghee.
Seal with foil and cook on lowest heat for 30 minutes.
Serve with raita and mint chutney.

recipes.title: Kebab Koobideh
instructions: Grate onion and squeeze out all juice. Mix with ground lamb and beef.
Add turmeric, pepper, baking soda, and salt. Knead 5 minutes.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Mold onto wide flat skewers using wet hands.
Grill over hot charcoal for 4 minutes per side.
Serve with saffron rice, grilled tomatoes, and flatbread.

recipes.title: Pita with Falafel
instructions: Blend soaked chickpeas with onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, and parsley.
Form into balls and deep fry at 180C until golden.
Make Israeli salad: diced tomato, cucumber, and parsley with lemon and olive oil.
Warm pita breads.
Fill with falafel, Israeli salad, and pickles.
Top generously with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Moussaka
instructions: Slice and salt eggplant, rest 30 minutes. Pat dry and fry until golden.
Make meat sauce: brown lamb with onion, garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, and allspice.
Make bechamel with butter, flour, milk, and egg yolks.
Layer eggplant, meat sauce, and bechamel in a baking dish.
Top with remaining bechamel and Kefalotyri cheese.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes until golden. Rest 20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma
instructions: Cube and salt eggplant. Rest 30 minutes, pat dry.
Fry eggplant in olive oil until golden. Drain.
Make tomato sauce with garlic, crushed tomatoes, and basil.
Cook rigatoni until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and eggplant.
Top with ricotta salata and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Pissaladiere
instructions: Slowly caramelize sliced onions in olive oil for 45 minutes until very soft and sweet.
Make or use store-bought pizza dough.
Roll dough into a rectangle on a baking sheet.
Spread caramelized onions over the dough.
Arrange anchovies in a lattice pattern and press olives into diamonds.
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until crust is golden.

recipes.title: Grilled Sardines with Salsa Verde
instructions: Clean and butterfly fresh sardines.
Season with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill over very high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Make salsa verde: blend parsley, capers, anchovy, garlic, lemon, and olive oil.
Serve sardines immediately with salsa verde.
Accompany with grilled bread and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Socca
instructions: Mix chickpea flour with water, olive oil, salt, and cumin until smooth.
Rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a cast iron pan with olive oil under the broiler until smoking.
Pour in batter and broil for 5-8 minutes until edges are crispy.
The center should be slightly soft.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately with rosemary and sea salt.

recipes.title: Borek
instructions: Make filling: mix crumbled feta with cooked spinach and eggs.
Brush phyllo sheets with olive oil and butter mixture.
Layer 4 sheets, add filling, and roll into a log.
Coil the log into a spiral in a round baking dish.
Brush top with egg yolk mixed with milk.
Bake at 180C for 35-40 minutes until deeply golden.

recipes.title: Risotto al Limone
instructions: Saute shallots in butter until soft. Add arborio rice and toast.
Add white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly.
After 20 minutes, remove from heat.
Stir in butter, Parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
Rest 2 minutes. Serve with extra Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Osso Buco
instructions: Season veal shanks and dredge in flour.
Brown on both sides in olive oil. Remove.
Saute onion, carrot, and celery until soft.
Add white wine and reduce. Add tomatoes and broth.
Return veal, cover and braise at 160C for 1.5-2 hours.
Make gremolata: lemon zest, garlic, and parsley. Serve over saffron risotto.

recipes.title: Gambas al Ajillo
instructions: Heat olive oil generously in a clay pot or heavy pan.
Add thinly sliced garlic and dried red chili. Cook until golden.
Add shrimp in a single layer.
Cook 1-2 minutes per side until just pink.
Add sherry or white wine and let it sizzle.
Season with salt and garnish with fresh parsley. Serve sizzling with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Panzanella
instructions: Tear stale bread into chunks and toast in olive oil until golden.
Chop ripe tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and basil.
Make dressing: red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Toss bread with tomatoes and dress generously.
Let sit 20 minutes so bread absorbs the juices.
Serve at room temperature with extra basil.

recipes.title: Tortilla Espanola
instructions: Slowly fry thin potato slices and onion in a generous amount of olive oil for 20 minutes.
Drain potatoes and mix with beaten eggs. Season well.
Return mixture to a medium pan with some oil.
Cook on low heat until edges set.
Flip using a plate and slide back in. Cook 3 more minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Puttanesca Pizza
instructions: Make or use pizza dough. Stretch into a thin round.
Spread crushed tomatoes with garlic and olive oil.
Top with anchovies, black olives, capers, and chili flakes.
Add torn mozzarella.
Bake at 250C for 10-12 minutes until charred and bubbling.
Finish with fresh parsley and extra olive oil.

recipes.title: Brodetto di Pesce
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and chili in olive oil.
Add white wine and vinegar. Reduce by half.
Add crushed tomatoes and fish broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add firm fish first, then shellfish in order of cooking time.
Cover and cook until all seafood is just done.
Serve with grilled bread rubbed with garlic.

recipes.title: Dolmades
instructions: Rinse grape leaves and blanch briefly in hot water.
Make filling: mix rice, onion, pine nuts, currants, mint, and olive oil.
Place a spoonful of filling at the base of each leaf. Fold sides in and roll.
Layer seam side down in a pot lined with lemon slices.
Pour lemon juice, olive oil, and water over. Weigh down with a plate.
Simmer covered for 40-45 minutes. Serve with tzatziki.

recipes.title: Caponata
instructions: Fry cubed eggplant in olive oil until golden. Drain.
Saute celery, onion, and capers.
Add crushed tomatoes, olives, and sugar.
Add red wine vinegar and cook until absorbed.
Fold in eggplant and toasted pine nuts.
Rest at room temperature for 1 hour. Serve as antipasto.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze out all moisture in a cloth.
Mix drained cucumber with thick Greek yogurt.
Add minced garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.
Fold in freshly chopped dill and mint.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour for flavors to develop.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and a sprig of dill.

recipes.title: Caldo Verde
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add sliced chorizo and cook 3 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and chicken broth. Simmer 20 minutes.
Mash some potatoes in the pot to thicken the soup.
Add very thinly shredded kale and cook 5 minutes.
Season and serve with crusty bread and drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Acqua Pazza
instructions: Saute garlic and chili in olive oil in a wide pan.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook until burst.
Add white wine and let it reduce.
Pour in water or fish broth.
Add fish fillets skin side down. Spoon liquid over fish.
Cook 8-10 minutes until fish is just done. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Lamb Souvlaki
instructions: Cut lamb into cubes. Marinate in olive oil, lemon, garlic, and oregano.
Thread onto skewers alternating with peppers and onion.
Grill over high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill.
Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, and onion.

recipes.title: Tiella di Riso, Patate e Cozze
instructions: Scrub and open mussels. Reserve the liquid.
Layer sliced potatoes in an oiled baking dish.
Add a layer of raw arborio rice mixed with tomatoes and onion.
Arrange mussels on top, still in their shells.
Pour mussel liquid, water, and olive oil over everything.
Top with Pecorino and bake at 180C for 50-60 minutes until rice is cooked.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Merguez
instructions: Brown merguez sausage in a pan, breaking it up.
Add onion, peppers, and garlic. Cook until soft.
Add harissa, cumin, and smoked paprika.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Create wells and crack in eggs. Cover and cook 5-7 minutes.
Garnish with feta, cilantro, and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Salade Nicoise
instructions: Boil eggs for 7 minutes. Cool and quarter.
Blanch green beans until just tender. Rinse in cold water.
Boil potatoes until tender. Quarter.
Make dressing: Dijon mustard, olive oil, lemon, anchovies, and herbs.
Sear tuna steaks rare in a hot pan.
Arrange lettuce, tomatoes, olives, eggs, beans, potatoes, and tuna. Dress and serve.

recipes.title: Imam Bayildi
instructions: Halve eggplants lengthwise. Score flesh and fry skin side down in olive oil.
Make filling: saute onion, garlic, and tomatoes with spices.
Fill eggplant halves with the tomato mixture.
Place in a baking dish and pour olive oil and water around them.
Bake covered at 180C for 45 minutes.
Serve at room temperature with yogurt and bread.

recipes.title: Loukoumades
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and warm water into a thin batter. Rest 1 hour.
Heat oil to 180C for deep frying.
Drop tablespoons of batter into oil using a wet spoon.
Fry until puffed and golden, turning constantly.
Drain and immediately drizzle with honey.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and crushed walnuts. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chermoula Fish
instructions: Make chermoula: blend cilantro, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon, and olive oil.
Score fish fillets and rub with half the chermoula.
Marinate 30 minutes.
Grill or bake at 200C for 15-18 minutes.
Serve with remaining chermoula as a sauce.
Accompany with couscous and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Arancini
instructions: Make saffron risotto and cool completely.
Make ragu filling with ground beef, peas, and tomato.
Take a handful of rice, flatten, add filling, and close into a ball.
Coat in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry at 180C for 4-5 minutes until golden.
Drain and serve immediately with marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Ful Medames
instructions: Simmer fava beans with garlic and cumin until very soft.
Mash about half the beans roughly.
Season with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Serve in bowls topped with chopped tomato and parsley.
Drizzle with more olive oil and a sprinkle of cumin.
Serve with warm pita and sliced vegetables.

recipes.title: Kafta bil Saniyeh
instructions: Mix ground beef with onion, parsley, allspice, cinnamon, and salt.
Spread meat mixture in a baking dish in an even layer.
Top with sliced tomatoes and onion rings.
Make tahini sauce with tahini, lemon juice, water, and garlic.
Pour tahini sauce over everything.
Bake at 180C for 35-40 minutes. Serve with rice and pita.

recipes.title: Muhammara
instructions: Roast red bell peppers under broiler until blackened. Peel and deseed.
Toast walnuts until fragrant.
Blend peppers, walnuts, pomegranate molasses, cumin, and Aleppo pepper.
Add breadcrumbs and olive oil. Blend until spreadable.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with walnuts.

recipes.title: Loubia
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add cumin, paprika, and harissa. Cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and white beans.
Simmer 30 minutes until sauce thickens.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
Serve warm with crusty bread and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Tagine of Lamb with Apricots
instructions: Brown lamb in olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, saffron, and ras el hanout.
Pour in broth and honey. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 1 hour.
Add dried apricots and almonds. Cook 20 more minutes.
Serve with couscous and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Kibbeh
instructions: Soak bulgur wheat and squeeze dry. Mix with ground lamb, onion, and spices.
Make filling: saute ground lamb with onion, pine nuts, and spices.
Take balls of the outer mixture, hollow out, fill, and seal.
Shape into footballs.
Deep fry at 175C until golden brown.
Serve with tzatziki and fresh salad.

recipes.title: Knafeh
instructions: Make sugar syrup with rose water and orange blossom water. Cool.
Shred kataifi dough and mix with melted butter.
Press half into a buttered baking dish.
Fill with a layer of unsalted cheese or cream.
Top with remaining dough and press firmly.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden. Immediately pour cold syrup over hot knafeh.

recipes.title: Shakshuka Khodra
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add zucchini, spinach, and kale. Cook until wilted.
Season with cumin, turmeric, and lemon zest.
Make wells in the vegetable mixture.
Crack in eggs and cover. Cook until whites are set.
Top with crumbled feta, za'atar, and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Mujaddara Hamra
instructions: Cook red lentils with tomatoes, onion, and spices until very soft.
Add bulgur wheat and cook until absorbed.
Caramelize sliced onions in olive oil until very dark.
Mix lentils and bulgur together.
Top with dark caramelized onions.
Serve with yogurt and chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Za'atar Roasted Chicken
instructions: Mix zaatar with olive oil, lemon zest, and garlic to make a paste.
Rub paste all over chicken, including under the skin.
Marinate at least 1 hour.
Roast at 200C for 45-55 minutes until juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before carving.
Serve with roasted vegetables, pita, and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken breast in broth with onion, celery, and bay leaf.
Remove chicken and shred.
Add orzo to the broth and cook until al dente.
Make avgolemono: whisk eggs with lemon juice.
Slowly ladle hot broth into egg mixture while whisking.
Return mixture to pot off heat. Add chicken. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Sfeeha (Lebanese Meat Pies)
instructions: Make dough with flour, yeast, oil, and salt. Rest 1 hour.
Make filling: mix ground lamb with onion, tomato, pomegranate molasses, and spices.
Divide dough into small balls and flatten into circles.
Place filling in center and fold up edges to make a square or triangle.
Bake at 200C for 15-20 minutes until golden.
Serve warm with yogurt and fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Falafel Bowl
instructions: Make falafel from soaked chickpeas and fry until crispy.
Cook bulgur or quinoa as a base.
Make Israeli salad with tomatoes, cucumber, and parsley.
Make tahini sauce with tahini, lemon, garlic, and water.
Arrange grains, salad, and falafel in bowls.
Top with tahini, pickled turnip, and sumac.

recipes.title: Harira
instructions: Brown lamb pieces in olive oil. Add onion, celery, and garlic.
Add canned tomatoes, lentils, and chickpeas.
Season with turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, and pepper.
Pour in broth and simmer 40 minutes.
Add vermicelli noodles and fresh herbs in last 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with dates and chebakia.
